data.case_title: Locksmith invoice for emergency door opening
data.explanation: A locksmith who unlocked your apartment door in an emergency call-out has billed you €266.56, made up of the door-opening fee, a night/Sunday-and-holiday surcharge, a travel charge, and VAT. Payment is due by the deadline shown, counted from when you received this invoice. Check that the price seems reasonable for the service before paying, then transfer the amount to the IBAN given, quoting the invoice number. Labor costs for household services like this can sometimes be deducted on your tax return (§35a EStG household services), so it's worth keeping this invoice and your bank transfer record. If anything about the charge seems off, contact the company directly to clarify before paying.
